description.p: GerGit is a desktop Git client for Linux. Every operation runs the system git command, so repositories, hooks and configuration behave exactly as on the command line.

ul.li: Commit graph with search, branches, remotes, tags, stashes, worktrees and submodules
Stage files, hunks or single lines; commit, amend, and commit and push in one step
Inline and side-by-side diff, image diff, blame and file history
Interactive rebase and a three-pane conflict resolver
GitHub and GitLab accounts with pull and merge requests
